note: Fail-first evidence for brief 21's same-head external-prerequisite exemption. Each mutation disarms ONE fail-closed guard in the deskkit decision; re-applying it turns the named negative-path test RED (muhar reports it CAUGHT), which is the proof the test actually pins that guard. The control makes the positive path fail, proving the suite runs. NOT IN THIS SWEEP, deliberately: the mixed-content guard is DOUBLY layered — the CR-block check (d.HasContentBlocker in ParsePrereqDeclaration) AND the ledger-derived in.OpenContentDefects (hasOpenContentDefect over the review records). Disarming either single clause leaves the other, so no single-clause mutation reddens it; the behaviour is pinned by TestExternalPrerequisiteMixedAndForged/mixed_content_finding_blocks, which exercises both clauses.

control.name: CONTROL — never grant the exemption (the positive path must go red)
control.old:
dec.Cleared = true
	dec.Reason = "every declared external prerequisite independently verified as changed after the rejection, at the unchanged head"
control.new:
dec.Cleared = false
	dec.Reason = "every declared external prerequisite independently verified as changed after the rejection, at the unchanged head"

mutations.name: disarm the could-not-check guard (unreadable evidence clears) — TestExternalPrerequisiteMixedAndForged/unreadable_source_data_blocks goes green
disarm the unrelated-object guard (any object clears) — TestExternalPrerequisiteMixedAndForged/unrelated_object_cannot_clear goes green
disarm the revocation guard (a revoked prerequisite still clears) — TestExternalPrerequisiteFreshnessAndLanes/later_revocation_blocks goes green
disarm the wrong-revision guard (any satisfying ref clears) — TestExternalPrerequisiteFreshnessAndLanes/wrong_revision_blocks goes green
disarm the freshness guard (a prerequisite predating the rejection clears) — TestExternalPrerequisiteFreshnessAndLanes/prerequisite_predating_the_rejection_blocks goes green
disarm the standing-security-failure guard (a security retraction is ignored) — TestExternalPrerequisiteFreshnessAndLanes/standing_security_failure_blocks goes green
